title: Five-dimensional research framework

stages.name: Normalized regime
stages.question: What kind of hydraulic–geometry state is this?

stages.name: Response magnitude
stages.question: How strongly does the selected response change?

stages.name: Dissipation-development demand
stages.question: What does the jump require independently of forcing magnitude?

stages.name: Material / stability trade-off
stages.question: What is gained and paid for across competing responses?

stages.name: Foundation / scour uncertainty
stages.question: How much uncertainty remains in the foundation/scour branch?

conclusion: No single family, scalar index or empirical scour equation captures all five dimensions.
boundary: Research synthesis only; not construction-ready design guidance.
